intake.title: Rafiq · intake assistant
intake.subtitle: An AI assistant; a human professional reviews what you say
intake.talkToPerson: I want to talk to a person
intake.contactRequested: We got your request. Someone from our team will contact you soon, and you can keep chatting if you like.
intake.question: {instrument} · question {item} of {total}
intake.composerHint: Enter sends your message; Shift and Enter start a new line.
intake.finishHint: You can end the conversation once we've got to know you a little more.
intake.finishing: Writing a summary of what you shared…
intake.pausedBody: You can come back within 14 days, until {date}, and we'll pick up where you left off.
intake.expiredBody: More than 14 days passed without a reply, so the conversation was closed. You can start again whenever you like.
intake.queued: We'll send it when you're back online
intake.offline: You're offline right now. Your message is saved and we'll send it automatically when the connection returns.
intake.tooLong: Your message is longer than {max} characters. Please send it in parts, one message at a time.
intake.contactConfirmTitle: Connect you with a person from our team?
intake.contactConfirmBody: We will send your request to our team, and a professional will contact you within {hours} hours at most. You can keep chatting while you wait.
intake.contactConfirm: Yes, ask them to contact me
intake.contactRequestedBy: We got your request. Someone from our team will contact you before {time}, and you can keep chatting if you like.
intake.formOffer: The assistant is not available right now. You can continue with the question form; what you have done so far is saved.
intake.formModeOn: Form mode: answer the questions one at a time, then write your own summary in the next step.
